workingDirectory: The root of the complete maintained repository with the joined source below.

runtime.network: Only the original loopback HTTP service is contacted by this programme.
runtime.sourceProvider: The original Xero Accounting JSON schema fixtures are constructed inside this private lifecycle. Source observations and exact bytes are retained by the production receiver.

dependencyClosure: Use the complete maintained source checkout or selected merchant-receivables recipe with its original declared dependency closure. The listed paths identify the business owners; they are not a replacement import resolver.
lifecycle: Original private AccountingWorkspace and maintained Xero loopback server, customer, issuer, three first-cycle invoices, exact receipt allocations and retained bank-credit coverage.
Original Xero templates, prepared document handover and native JSON receiving establish source UUIDs before cash matching.
Direct payments, applied prepayments and overpayments are matched separately; payment currency, bank currency and IsReconciled remain distinct.
First cash cycle is captured and replayed with the exact retained operation; source and native files remain immutable.
Second billing invoice receives an original paid-invoice credit disposition and prepaid cash; an actual operator-recorded overpayment refund retains the original outflow.
The Xero cross-invoice credit representation consumes shared original credit, target allocation and released cash capacities once per cycle.
Actual previews exercise an inconsistent source remainder, omitted cash fields, declared payment totals with empty detail, and competing source matches without changing the ledger.
Second cycle retains original source JSON, customer cash advice, CSV/HTML reports, immutable baseline comparison and complete tar export.
Original AccountingWorkspace uncertain-commit metadata crosses the HTTP client before closing/reopening; exact original request replay, file SHA identities and dated cash recover on the same owner.

optionalEnvironment.SCF_CASH_AS_OF: A valid YYYY-MM-DD fixture account date; defaults to current UTC date.
optionalEnvironment.SCF_CASH_TMPDIR: Existing writable parent for the private temporary account.
optionalEnvironment.SCF_CASH_RESULT: Absolute destination for the resulting single JSON record.
optionalEnvironment.SCF_CASH_KEEP: Set to 1 to preserve the complete private account and handover files after success.

output.failure: Exact stage, original code/details/stack and retained directory.
output.success: Original package/cycle/native IDs, source hashes, unchanged invoice hashes and lifecycle outcomes.
